user_query.title: Implement Adaptive Rejection Sampler in R
user_query.text: Implement an adaptive-rejection sampler as described in Gilks et al. (1992), in R. Install R if not already available. Save the main implementation in /app/ars.R and include a primary function named 'ars' with signature ars(density_function, domain, n = sample_count). The solution should allow reasonable inputs, including the number of points to sample, and validate those inputs. The primary input should be a function or expression that calculates the possibly unnormalized density in a vectorized fashion, such as R's dnorm. Include checks that catch non-log-concave densities during sampling. Use modular code with functions or OOP methods for discrete tasks and a consistent overall design and style. Include a test function named 'test' that performs formal testing against known distributions and prints clear, interpretable output in the format 'TEST_NAME: PASS' or 'TEST_NAME: FAIL' with mean and standard deviation statistics; test the overall function and any complicated modules. The 'ars' function must generate valid samples from standard distributions such as normal and exponential, and the generated samples must follow the target distribution shape rather than being uniform random values. Include clear error handling for invalid inputs and non-log-concave densities. Generate at least one sample file named /app/normal_samples.txt or /app/exponential_samples.txt containing the test samples.

cat > /app/ars.R << 'EOF'
###############################################################################
##  ars.R -- Adaptive Rejection Sampling (Gilks & Wild, 1992, JRSS-C 41:337)
##
##  Main user-facing function:
##      ars(density_function, domain, n)
##
##  Formal test suite:
##      test()
###############################################################################

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Input validation
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
validate_inputs <- function(density_function, domain, n) {
  if (!is.function(density_function))
    stop("ars: 'density_function' must be a function returning (possibly unnormalized) density values")
  if (!is.numeric(n) || length(n) != 1 || is.na(n) || n <= 0 || n != floor(n))
    stop("ars: 'n' must be a single positive integer")
  if (!is.numeric(domain) || length(domain) != 2 || any(is.na(domain)))
    stop("ars: 'domain' must be a numeric vector of length 2, e.g. c(-Inf, Inf)")
  if (domain[1] >= domain[2])
    stop("ars: invalid domain: domain[1] must be strictly less than domain[2]")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Log-density and its numerical derivative
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_h <- function(density_function) {
  function(x) {
    fx <- density_function(x)
    if (!is.numeric(fx) || length(fx) != length(x))
      stop("ars: 'density_function' must be vectorized and return one numeric value per input")
    if (any(is.na(fx)) || any(fx < 0))
      stop("ars: 'density_function' returned NA/NaN or negative values")
    log(fx)
  }
}

h_prime <- function(h, x, eps = 1e-6) {
  (h(x + eps) - h(x - eps)) / (2 * eps)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. Log-concavity check: slopes of log-density must be non-increasing in x
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
check_log_concave <- function(hpx, tol = 1e-5) {
  if (any(diff(hpx) > tol))
    stop("ars: density is not log-concave (slope of log-density increased between abscissae)")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. Hull construction (upper tangent hull and lower chord squeeze)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_z <- function(state, domain) {
  x <- state$x; hx <- state$hx; hp <- state$hpx
  k <- length(x)
  if (k < 2) return(c(domain[1], domain[2]))
  den <- hp[-k] - hp[-1]
  num <- hx[-1] - hx[-k] - x[-1] * hp[-1] + x[-k] * hp[-k]
  z <- ifelse(abs(den) < 1e-8, (x[-k] + x[-1]) / 2, num / den)
  ## for a log-concave density z[j] must lie in [x[j], x[j+1]]; clamp for safety
  z <- pmin(pmax(z, x[-k]), x[-1])
  c(domain[1], z, domain[2])
}

eval_upper <- function(state, xs) {
  j <- findInterval(xs, state$z, all.inside = TRUE)
  state$hx[j] + (xs - state$x[j]) * state$hpx[j]
}

eval_lower <- function(state, xs) {
  x <- state$x; hx <- state$hx
  k <- length(x)
  out <- rep(-Inf, length(xs))
  inside <- xs >= x[1] & xs <= x[k]
  if (any(inside)) {
    j <- findInterval(xs[inside], x, all.inside = TRUE)
    out[inside] <- (hx[j] * (x[j + 1] - xs[inside]) +
                    hx[j + 1] * (xs[inside] - x[j])) / (x[j + 1] - x[j])
  }
  out
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. Sampling from the piecewise-exponential upper hull (inverse CDF)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sample_upper <- function(state) {
  x <- state$x; hx <- state$hx; hp <- state$hpx; z <- state$z
  k <- length(x)
  m <- max(hx)
  zl <- z[1:k]; zr <- z[2:(k + 1)]
  areas <- numeric(k)
  for (j in 1:k) {
    if (abs(hp[j]) < 1e-10) {
      areas[j] <- exp(hx[j] - m) * (zr[j] - zl[j])
    } else {
      el <- if (is.finite(zl[j])) exp(hp[j] * (zl[j] - x[j])) else if (hp[j] > 0) 0 else Inf
      er <- if (is.finite(zr[j])) exp(hp[j] * (zr[j] - x[j])) else if (hp[j] < 0) 0 else Inf
      areas[j] <- exp(hx[j] - m) * (er - el) / hp[j]
    }
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(areas)) || sum(areas) <= 0)
    stop("ars: upper hull is not integrable; the density may be improper or non-log-concave")
  j <- if (k == 1) 1 else sample.int(k, 1, prob = areas)
  u <- runif(1)
  if (abs(hp[j]) < 1e-10) {
    zl[j] + u * (zr[j] - zl[j])
  } else {
    el <- if (is.finite(zl[j])) exp(hp[j] * (zl[j] - x[j])) else 0
    er <- if (is.finite(zr[j])) exp(hp[j] * (zr[j] - x[j])) else 0
    x[j] + log(el + u * (er - el)) / hp[j]
  }
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 6. Updating the state with a newly evaluated abscissa
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
update_state <- function(state, xnew, hnew, hpnew, domain, max_points = 50) {
  if (!is.finite(xnew) || !is.finite(hnew) || !is.finite(hpnew)) return(state)
  if (length(state$x) >= max_points) return(state)
  ord <- order(c(state$x, xnew))
  x   <- c(state$x,   xnew)[ord]
  hx  <- c(state$hx,  hnew)[ord]
  hpx <- c(state$hpx, hpnew)[ord]
  check_log_concave(hpx)
  new_state <- list(x = x, hx = hx, hpx = hpx)
  new_state$z <- compute_z(new_state, domain)
  new_state
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 7. Initialization of the abscissae
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
init_state <- function(h, domain, k = 6) {
  lower <- domain[1]; upper <- domain[2]
  delta <- 1e-4
  lo <- if (is.finite(lower)) lower + delta * max(1, abs(lower)) else NA
  hi <- if (is.finite(upper)) upper - delta * max(1, abs(upper)) else NA
  if (!is.finite(upper)) {
    hi <- if (is.finite(lower)) lo + 1 else 1
    ok <- FALSE
    for (i in 1:60) {
      d <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(h_prime(h, hi), error = function(e) NA))
      if (is.finite(d) && d < 0) { ok <- TRUE; break }
      hi <- abs(hi) * 2 + 1
    }
    if (!ok) stop("ars: could not find a starting point with negative log-density slope in the right tail; density may be improper on this domain")
  }
  if (!is.finite(lower)) {
    lo <- min(-1, hi - 1)
    ok <- FALSE
    for (i in 1:60) {
      d <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(h_prime(h, lo), error = function(e) NA))
      if (is.finite(d) && d > 0) { ok <- TRUE; break }
      lo <- -(abs(lo) * 2 + 1)
    }
    if (!ok) stop("ars: could not find a starting point with positive log-density slope in the left tail; density may be improper on this domain")
  }
  if (!(lo < hi)) stop("ars: failed to initialize abscissae (lo >= hi)")
  xs  <- seq(lo, hi, length.out = k)
  hx  <- suppressWarnings(h(xs))
  hpx <- suppressWarnings(h_prime(h, xs))
  keep <- is.finite(hx) & is.finite(hpx)
  xs <- xs[keep]; hx <- hx[keep]; hpx <- hpx[keep]
  if (length(xs) < 2)
    stop("ars: could not find at least two valid starting abscissae; check the density and the domain")
  check_log_concave(hpx)
  if (!is.finite(lower) && hpx[1] <= 0)
    stop("ars: initialization failed: leftmost slope must be positive when the domain is unbounded below")
  if (!is.finite(upper) && hpx[length(hpx)] >= 0)
    stop("ars: initialization failed: rightmost slope must be negative when the domain is unbounded above")
  state <- list(x = xs, hx = hx, hpx = hpx)
  state$z <- compute_z(state, domain)
  state
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 8. Main sampler
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ars <- function(density_function, domain, n = 1000) {
  validate_inputs(density_function, domain, n)
  h <- make_h(density_function)
  state <- init_state(h, domain)
  samples <- numeric(n)
  n_accept <- 0
  tol_violation <- 1e-3
  max_iter <- max(10000, 200 * n)
  iter <- 0
  while (n_accept < n) {
    iter <- iter + 1
    if (iter > max_iter)
      stop("ars: maximum number of iterations exceeded; sampling failed")
    xstar <- sample_upper(state)
    if (!is.finite(xstar) || xstar < domain[1] || xstar > domain[2]) next
    w  <- runif(1)
    ux <- eval_upper(state, xstar)
    lx <- eval_lower(state, xstar)
    if (lx > ux + tol_violation)
      stop("ars: non-log-concavity detected (squeeze function exceeds the upper hull)")
    if (w <= exp(lx - ux)) {
      ## accepted via squeeze test -- no density evaluation needed
      n_accept <- n_accept + 1
      samples[n_accept] <- xstar
    } else {
      hxs <- h(xstar)
      if (is.finite(hxs) && hxs > ux + tol_violation)
        stop("ars: non-log-concavity detected (log-density exceeds the upper hull)")
      if (w <= exp(hxs - ux)) {
        n_accept <- n_accept + 1
        samples[n_accept] <- xstar
      }
      hps <- suppressWarnings(tryCatch(h_prime(h, xstar), error = function(e) NA))
      state <- update_state(state, xstar, hxs, hps, domain)
    }
  }
  samples
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 9. Formal test suite
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
test <- function() {
  cat("============================================================\n")
  cat(" Adaptive Rejection Sampler (Gilks & Wild 1992) test suite\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  set.seed(20240131)
  all_pass <- TRUE

  cat("\n[1] Sampling 5000 draws from N(0,1) via ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf)) ...\n")
  s1 <- ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf), n = 5000)
  m1 <- mean(s1); sd1 <- sd(s1)
  ks1 <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(s1, "pnorm")$p.value)
  p1 <- abs(m1) < 0.1 && abs(sd1 - 1) < 0.1 && ks1 > 0.005
  cat(sprintf("    expected mean = 0, sd = 1; Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value = %.4f\n", ks1))
  cat(sprintf("NORMAL_TEST: %s (mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f)\n", if (p1) "PASS" else "FAIL", m1, sd1))
  write(s1, file = "/app/normal_samples.txt", ncolumns = 1)
  cat("    samples saved to /app/normal_samples.txt\n")
  all_pass <- all_pass && p1

  cat("\n[2] Sampling 5000 draws from Exp(1) via ars(dexp, c(0, Inf)) ...\n")
  s2 <- ars(dexp, c(0, Inf), n = 5000)
  m2 <- mean(s2); sd2 <- sd(s2)
  ks2 <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(s2, "pexp")$p.value)
  p2 <- abs(m2 - 1) < 0.1 && abs(sd2 - 1) < 0.12 && ks2 > 0.005
  cat(sprintf("    expected mean = 1, sd = 1; Kolmogorov-Smirnov p-value = %.4f\n", ks2))
  cat(sprintf("EXPONENTIAL_TEST: %s (mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f)\n", if (p2) "PASS" else "FAIL", m2, sd2))
  write(s2, file = "/app/exponential_samples.txt", ncolumns = 1)
  cat("    samples saved to /app/exponential_samples.txt\n")
  all_pass <- all_pass && p2

  cat("\n[3] Sampling 5000 draws from Gamma(shape=3) on (0, Inf) ...\n")
  s3 <- ars(function(x) dgamma(x, shape = 3), c(0, Inf), n = 5000)
  m3 <- mean(s3); sd3 <- sd(s3)
  ks3 <- suppressWarnings(ks.test(s3, "pgamma", shape = 3)$p.value)
  p3 <- abs(m3 - 3) < 0.15 && abs(sd3 - sqrt(3)) < 0.15 && ks3 > 0.005
  cat(sprintf("    expected mean = 3, sd = %.4f; KS p-value = %.4f\n", sqrt(3), ks3))
  cat(sprintf("GAMMA_TEST: %s (mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f)\n", if (p3) "PASS" else "FAIL", m3, sd3))
  all_pass <- all_pass && p3

  cat("\n[4] Sampling 3000 draws from an *unnormalized* normal kernel exp(-x^2/2) ...\n")
  s4 <- ars(function(x) exp(-x^2 / 2), c(-Inf, Inf), n = 3000)
  m4 <- mean(s4); sd4 <- sd(s4)
  p4 <- abs(m4) < 0.12 && abs(sd4 - 1) < 0.12
  cat(sprintf("UNNORMALIZED_TEST: %s (mean=%.4f, sd=%.4f)\n", if (p4) "PASS" else "FAIL", m4, sd4))
  all_pass <- all_pass && p4

  cat("\n[5] Module test: upper hull dominates log-density, lower hull is dominated ...\n")
  hfun <- make_h(dnorm)
  st <- init_state(hfun, c(-Inf, Inf))
  xs <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 201)
  uv <- eval_upper(st, xs); lv <- eval_lower(st, xs); hv <- hfun(xs)
  p5 <- all(uv >= hv - 1e-6) && all(lv <= hv + 1e-6)
  cat(sprintf("HULL_TEST: %s (max(h-u)=%.2e, max(l-h)=%.2e)\n",
              if (p5) "PASS" else "FAIL", max(hv - uv), max(lv - hv)))
  all_pass <- all_pass && p5

  cat("\n[6] Input validation: invalid inputs must raise errors ...\n")
  e1 <- inherits(tryCatch(ars(dnorm, c(-Inf, Inf), n = -5), error = function(e) e), "error")
  cat(sprintf("INVALID_N_TEST: %s (negative sample count rejected)\n", if (e1) "PASS" else "FAIL"))
  e2 <- inherits(tryCatch(ars(dnorm, c(2, -2), n = 100), error = function(e) e), "error")
  cat(sprintf("INVALID_DOMAIN_TEST: %s (reversed domain rejected)\n", if (e2) "PASS" else "FAIL"))
  e3 <- inherits(tryCatch(ars("not_a_function", c(-Inf, Inf), n = 100), error = function(e) e), "error")
  cat(sprintf("INVALID_DENSITY_TEST: %s (non-function density rejected)\n", if (e3) "PASS" else "FAIL"))
  all_pass <- all_pass && e1 && e2 && e3

  cat("\n[7] Non-log-concave densities must be detected during sampling ...\n")
  e4 <- tryCatch({ ars(dcauchy, c(-Inf, Inf), n = 2000); NULL }, error = function(e) e)
  ok4 <- inherits(e4, "error")
  if (ok4) cat("    caught expected error: ", conditionMessage(e4), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("NON_LOG_CONCAVE_CAUCHY_TEST: %s\n", if (ok4) "PASS" else "FAIL"))
  mix <- function(x) 0.5 * dnorm(x, -3) + 0.5 * dnorm(x, 3)
  e5 <- tryCatch({ ars(mix, c(-Inf, Inf), n = 2000); NULL }, error = function(e) e)
  ok5 <- inherits(e5, "error")
  if (ok5) cat("    caught expected error: ", conditionMessage(e5), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("NON_LOG_CONCAVE_MIXTURE_TEST: %s\n", if (ok5) "PASS" else "FAIL"))
  all_pass <- all_pass && ok4 && ok5

  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat(sprintf("OVERALL: %s\n", if (all_pass) "ALL TESTS PASSED" else "SOME TESTS FAILED"))
  cat("============================================================\n")
  invisible(all_pass)
}
EOF
